onpage.description_missing.title: 2 pages have no meta description
onpage.description_missing.detail: The description is the sales pitch under the headline in search results. Without one Google extracts an arbitrary sentence from the page, often a cookie notice or a nav label.
onpage.description_missing.fix: Write a 120–155 character description per page: what the page offers and why to click.

onpage.description_long.title: 1 meta description exceeds 165 characters
onpage.description_long.detail: The tail gets truncated with an ellipsis, so any call to action at the end is lost.
onpage.description_long.fix: Trim to under 165 characters with the key message first.

onpage.description_short.title: 1 meta description is very short
onpage.description_short.detail: Short descriptions leave free advertising space unused in the search result.
onpage.description_short.fix: Expand to 120–155 characters and include a reason to click.

index.duplicate_descriptions.title: 2 pages share a duplicated meta description
index.duplicate_descriptions.detail: Duplicate descriptions get rewritten by Google, so you lose control of the snippet.
index.duplicate_descriptions.fix: Write a distinct description per page describing that page's specific offer.

after_desc.services: What a full typewriter service covers: strip, clean, oil, new ribbon, platen check and margin and tab setting. See what each step does to your machine.
